text.title: Rapid Fire
text.declared_mood: Dark, accusatory, chaotic, confrontational, self-aware, introspective
text.production_notes: Hard trap beat with distorted sliding 808s, rapid hi-hat triplets and rolls, punchy kicks and snappy snares, eerie pads and dark bell/pluck melodies, occasional beat dropouts for emphasis, hook layered with percussive vocal chops mimicking gunfire rhythm
text.vocal_notes: Aggressive trap delivery with rapid triplet flows and sharp enunciation, accusatory tone in first half, transitioning into conflicted/self-critical tone, punchy ad-libs (Yeah! / Facts! / Talk! / Damn!), hook delivered like a chant with percussive rhythm, machine-gun vocal cadence in pockets
